description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §2.12, §5.7, §5.9, decision 31): the market town on the Wend - its guards, wall archers, folk and Marchwarden Edda (members carry faction "brannock"). Neutral until offended: a blow on its people or damage to one of its houses warns, a second within 30 s turns the town hostile (so does smashing its south gatehouse, the march oath's force path). Its folk step aside for a giant at peace with them; hostile, its guards fight inside its walls, its smithy shuts and a respawn at its waystone moves away while its guards stand within 120 m. Edda reconciles the town for 2 iron. The oath's outcomes set allied (help) or tribute (intimidate), shown on site.

reconcile.text: Pay for the harm you did (2 iron)

warn_text: Brannock's folk scatter from your feet. Strike again and the town will fight you.
hostile_text: Brannock's bells ring: the town takes up arms.
reconciled_text: Brannock forgives the harm, if not the fright.
